results.description: Five CUDA replicas: nodal and field agreement, thresholded overlap, angle percentiles and first extension.
Two 6116-step AT2 bound-treatment runs: terminal fields, crack tip, energy, feasibility and irreversibility.
Consistent versus row-sum-lumped damage reaction: terminal field differences and clipped support area.
Damage cadences 1, 2 and 3: threshold-crossing delays, tips, energy differences and three CPU timing repeats per cadence.
Four joint space/time refinements: analytical standing-wave errors and observed orders recomputed from retained errors.
Fixed-length-scale SENT refinement: dissipation, speed, threshold and post-ramp interval sensitivity across three meshes.
Linear-ramp SENT boundary arrival and median crack speeds from sampled tip histories.
C2 displacement-ramp work balance, boundary inertia and terminal damage; distinct from the linear-ramp benchmark.
Separate 57482-step constant-traction SENT calculation and recorded normalised energy imbalance.
Five-mesh half-plate impact: initiation, final orientation and threshold sensitivity.
Branching energy accounting at 3676 saved post-ramp states, excluding the ramp, between-state extrema and final unsaved updates.
Historical perforated-plate geometry and qualitative crack interactions; the cited 10-hole velocity trace is external literature.
30-hole retained speed records and specified clipping/filtering; the filtered peak is not an unfiltered physical peak speed.
Four offset/loading combinations: 14 holes inside the plate despite legacy 15-hole filenames; selected morphology only.
AT1 replay energy accounting over 1859 saved states, including the reported 9.9947% largest drift and -7.4893% final imbalance.
Cadence, maximum-history and current-energy controls, including non-improving controls; not independent constitutive validation or one convergence order.
Q1: 350 accepted targets, convergence measures and load peak comparison using a retrospectively recovered runtime mesh.
Q2: 200 accepted targets, force curve, residual and tangent-direction records. Replotting and saved-field checks do not independently recompute all these metrics.
Matched SENT: three-code protocol and five-implementation field-parity extension; extension timing is outside the reported CPU timing study.
Matched four-implementation Kalthoff fields, convergence, connected fronts, speed and threshold-dependent extension times.
Five balanced single-thread CPU processes: operator counts, steady-state timing, compilation and full-run costs on the recorded host.
Timing-run convergence and terminal field agreement, including compiled versus eager execution.
Scalar glass recovery, initial AD/FD comparison and accepted-state counts; pre-update closure losses are not post-update parameter losses.
Scalar alumina recovery and the unresolved 5.1% initial central-difference discrepancy; later sweeps do not replace the baseline.
Six noisy bounded starts: five meet the criterion, the upper-bound start fails; separate scalar Brent reference.
Cross-mesh target and three inverse meshes, fitting/check observations, Brent scan and distinct AD initialisation.
Cross-mesh parameter and observation errors, evaluation counts and stopping outcomes, including fine-mesh AD line-search failure.
Joint toughness/length-scale protocol: four starts, 16 physical increments, observation weights and 200 optimiser updates.
Selected optimiser evaluation 26 and stored terminal outcomes; one of four starts meets the criterion. Final physical increment is not optimiser evaluation 200.
Selected-state AD/FD discrepancy of 93.005% and primal replay checks; relative 1e-8 projected-KKT convergence remains unverified.
Twelve isolated AT2 custom/unrolled CUDA pairs: incremental memory and numerical agreement, not whole-trajectory memory or active-set-transition validation.
All 15 historical tolerance/perturbation rows retained; five published-tolerance rows plotted. Original mesh and observations remain unresolved.
Separate history-derivative and adjoint-tolerance replay; it does not attribute the original 5.1% discrepancy to a specific cause.
Software/hardware statements and runtime configurations, not an additional numerical study.
AMG eligibility, rebuild/fallback rules and algorithmic constants; no empirical AMG speedup study is claimed.
Algorithmic cost illustrations and prospective observation operators, not additional measured results.

New source statement: terminal AT2 local and gradient crack-surface-density contributions of 1.53 and 0.26 per unit crack length within 2 mm of the crack plane, compared with 0.5 each for the static profile. No independent analysis is claimed.
